epics.name: Test Document Management System
epics.description: A test system for managing and processing various types of documents with accessibility features.

features.name: Process Standard Document
features.description: This feature processes and formats standard documents for various output formats including PDF and text.

user_stories.name: Create Standard Document Files
user_stories.description:
- As a document services team member,
 - I want to create standard document files for each customer
 - so that I can ensure each customer receives their documents in the correct format.

use_cases.name: Create Standard Document Files
use_cases.data:
## Acceptance Criteria
- Standard document files are created for each customer.
- Each file is named according to the customer's document ID.
- The content of each file accurately reflects the customer's document data.
- Any issues with formatting are logged appropriately.
- Error handling is implemented for file creation failures.

## Business Notes
- The system must maintain document integrity.
- The output must be secure and maintain customer privacy.
use_cases.description: As a document services team member, I want to create standard document files for each customer so that I can ensure each customer receives their documents in the correct format.
use_cases.gherkin_syntax:
Background:
  Given the document services team is ready to process customer documents
  And the document data is available in the required format

Scenario: Create standard document file for a customer
  Given a customer with document ID <docid>
  When the team processes the document
  Then a standard document file named <docid>.pdf is created
  And the file contains the correct document information
  And any formatting issues are logged
  And if there are file creation errors, appropriate error messages are logged

Scenario Template: Handle formatting issues
  Given a customer with document ID <docid>
  When the document has formatting issues
  Then log "Document <docid> has formatting problems"

  Examples:
    | docid | 
    | DOC01 | 
    | DOC02 | 

Scenario Template: Handle file creation errors
  Given a customer with document ID <docid>
  When the system attempts to create the document file
  Then if the file creation fails
  Then log an error message indicating the failure

  Examples:
    | docid | 
    | DOC01 | 
    | DOC02 |

user_stories.name: Validate Document Headers
user_stories.description:
- As a document services team member,
 - I want to validate document headers for correctness
 - so that I can ensure compliance with document standards.

use_cases.name: Validate Document Headers
use_cases.data:
## Acceptance Criteria
- The system validates document headers starting from page 1.
- If a document header is missing or incorrect, a message is logged indicating the specific document ID and the issue.
- The validation process must handle multiple pages and report issues for each relevant page header.

## Business Notes
- Ensuring the correctness of document headers is crucial for compliance with document standards.
use_cases.description: As a document services team member, I want to validate document headers for correctness so that I can ensure compliance with document standards.
use_cases.gherkin_syntax:
Background:
  Given the document processing system is active
  And the document services team has access to the document files

Scenario: Validate document headers for correctness
  Given a document with multiple pages
  When the system validates the document headers starting from page 1
  Then the system checks each header for correctness
  And if a header is missing or incorrect, it logs "Document <docid> has header problems"

Scenario: Correctly formatted document headers
  Given a document with correctly formatted headers
  When the system validates the document headers
  Then no issues are logged

Scenario: Missing document header on page 1
  Given a document where page 1 is missing a header
  When the system validates the document headers
  Then it logs "Document <docid> has header problems"

Scenario: Incorrect document header format
  Given a document where page 1 has an incorrectly formatted header
  When the system validates the document headers
  Then it logs "Document <docid> has header problems"

features.name: Generate Report Summary
features.description: This feature generates summary reports for processed documents, including statistics and processing results.

user_stories.name: Create Processing Summary Report
user_stories.description:
- As a document services team member,
 - I want to generate a summary report of all processed documents
 - so that I can track processing statistics and identify any issues.

use_cases.name: Create Processing Summary Report
use_cases.data:
## Acceptance Criteria
- The summary report must include the total number of documents processed.
- The report should include a count of successful and failed processing attempts.
- The system must generate the report in a readable format.

## Business Notes
- The summary report helps track system performance and identify processing issues.
use_cases.description: As a document services team member, generate a summary report of all processed documents to track statistics.
use_cases.gherkin_syntax:
Background:
  Given the document services team is logged in to the reporting system
  And the system has processed multiple documents

Scenario: Generate a processing summary report
  Given documents have been processed
  When the system generates a summary report
  Then the report includes the total number of documents processed
  And the report includes counts of successful and failed processing attempts
  And the report is generated in a readable format

Scenario: Handle empty processing queue
  Given no documents have been processed
  When the system generates a summary report
  Then the report indicates zero documents processed
  And the system logs this information for review

Scenario: Handle report generation errors
  Given an error occurs during report generation
  When the system attempts to generate the summary report
  Then an error message is generated indicating the issue
  And the user is notified of the error
